chunks: And from him, from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from Safwan, from Rib'i, from Fudayl, from Zurara, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
"You should be among those who perform ablution from the milk, for indeed milk transmits impurity."
ai.seo_question: Does milk transmit ritual impurity in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) links the physical act of nursing to ritual purity, ruling that milk is a substance that transmits impurity (*al-labana yu'di*). This establishes the jurisprudential basis for performing *wudu* after contact with milk, reflecting the Shia scholarly view on the contagious nature of bodily fluids in matters of ritual cleanliness.
